'''Waks Trode''' was an [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] with [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] who was an industrialist and war profiteer during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="SWCTP" /> a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] that lasted from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> He often attended posh events in order to curry favor with [[Senator/Legends|senators]] in the Galactic Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]], allowing him to negotiate contracts.<ref name="SWCTP" /> In 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="ROTS date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Trode attended a showing<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> of the ballet ''[[Squid Lake/Legends|Squid Lake]]''<ref name="ROTS IS">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref> at the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]]<ref name="ROTS" /> in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]]<ref name="SWCTP" /> and conversed with fellow Ishi Tib,<ref name="ROTS" /> Senator [[Gume Saam/Legends|Gume Saam]].<ref name="ROTSVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>  The two were walking side-by-side in a corridor of the [[Opera/Legends|opera]] house when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ran past them to attend a meeting with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in his [[Palpatine's private viewing box|private viewing box]].<ref name="ROTS" /> While at the performance of ''Squid Lake'', Trode wore an old-gold colored [[Clothing/Legends|coat]] and [[Robe/Legends|robes]].<ref name="DaG">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Waks Trode was first pictured in "[[Material World]]," an interview with costume designer [[Trisha Biggar]] which was written by [[Brett Rector]] and published in the magazine [[Star Wars Insider 81|eighty-first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Material World">{{InsiderCite|81|Material World}}</ref> released on [[March 28]], [[2005]].<ref name="Insider 81">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050301.html|text=General Kenobi in ''Star Wars Insider'' #81}}</ref> Trode was later identified in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[James Luceno]]<ref name="ROTSVD" /> and released on [[April 2]] of that year,<ref name="ROTSVD release date">{{DK|url=us/9780756611286-star-wars-revenge-of-the-sith-the-visual-dictionary|text=Star Wars Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary|oldversion=20151018025119}}</ref> ahead of the release of the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] on [[May 19]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> Trode appeared in the film in its Galaxies Opera House corridor scene,<ref name="ROTS" /> which was shot entirely on blue-screen.<ref name="SkywalkerSage">''[[Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' &mdash; [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']]: "ILM Episode III Siggraph Reel"</ref> Trode was played by an uncredited extra<ref name="ROTS" /> wearing a costume consisting of an old-gold quilted silk coat and robes.<ref name="DaG" />
